'''Dorsk''' was the original [[Khommite/Legends|Khommite]] that started the [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] lineage that would later include [[Dorsk 79]], [[Dorsk 80]], [[Dorsk 81]], [[Dorsk 82]], and [[Dorsk 83]].<ref name="EGTAS" />
